works.body:
Thank you for the appeal!
Thank you for your support for the trekking project!
I see that Narunaru-san usually draws illustrations of the Eastern style!
Then, the character should be Cirno, and the theme should be "Events of the Four Seasons".
Please provide the following information.

Contents: Cirno / Events of the Four Seasons
Supplement: If possible, please consider the title and flavor text (i.e., lines or explanations to be displayed at the bottom of the card) and write them on a separate layer.
Uses: Trekkylust, books compiling Trekkies, card supplies, postage stamp-style stickers, clear files, PR for these
Size: 2500*3200pixel 350dpi (or size in the same ratio)

Secondary use of the illustrations, publication and distribution of the work is free.
Best regards.
